title: A Reduction to Binary Approach for Debiasing Multiclass Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It only mentions 'religion' once as an example of a non-binary sensitive attribute that its proposed debiasing method could theoretically handle.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as it was not an attribute used in any of the experiments. Religion was only mentioned as a motivating example of a non-binary sensitive attribute.
